name: Badges climb from bronze to diamond
looks: A short vertical list of badge icons, each with a name and a tier word underneath, steps up in material and colour through a tier ladder from a dull bronze to a glowing cool blue, rows climbing out of sync with each other. Once a badge lands on its top tier, a one-line stat clips in beside its label, and the shot holds on all badges glowing at full tier.
build: Same icon silhouette per row; only the fill gradient and rim-light colour tween through tier-colour stops (lerpColor on power2.inOut, under 0.3s per step). Row 2 starts 0.15-0.25s after row 1, row 3 after row 2. The stat clips in under the label via a width-mask once that row reaches its last tier, digits rolling up in the final 0.2s.
sound: A light chime per tier step, pitching upward with each tier, a slightly longer chime on each badge's final top-tier landing.
prompt: List a few status badges stacked vertically, each labelled with a name, and step every badge's icon up through a material and colour tier ladder (dull to precious) on its own offset timing so the rows climb out of sync. Once a badge reaches its top tier, clip in a one-line stat beside it, and hold the final frame with every badge glowing at full tier.
